samples.text: Digital health spent years trying to put medicine inside video games. Which is impressive, because Tetris may have accidentally gone the other direction.
In randomized studies, a brief visuospatial task after trauma was associated with fewer intrusive memories during follow-up. The finding is specific, and the mechanism is still being tested.
Which is awkward if your investment thesis was: blocks, but regulated.
The bigger question is not whether games are engaging. It is whether some ordinary software already contains a causal therapeutic mechanism.
